notes: Audited at main 6f63aaa read-only. Measurement is the weakest stage: no page analytics, no error monitoring, 11 competing event tables (3 without migrations incl. site00_project_events). Governance is strong as code libraries/docs but weakly enforced at runtime: reference-binding precheck (#1357-#1364) is tested but not invoked by any API/provider call path; founderConfirmedSpend is a client-supplied boolean; only Opus-native has a real pre-iteration cost ceiling. Canon/decision/incident knowledge lives in motherboard (MEMORY.md 1.49MB, CODEBASE.md stale since 2026-08-18) and ground-zero JSON that no code reads. CI red on main neutralises regression guards. Client-ready blockers in this domain kept to: project events ledger, review outcome capture (repair), error monitoring, spend guard rebuild, founder decision register status.
